payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Planning update: I'm Lawanna (10h avail, best skill ui-ux-design). I’m considering claiming one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux-design micro-task (review/docs/triage/test/implement). I will avoid data-science tasks due to very high cost. Please claim other tasks to avoid duplicates.
My likely picks (low cost): ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage each cost~1.09; ISSUE-0001::test cost 1.52; ISSUE-0001::implement cost 2.17. Please coordinate so only one agent picks each micro-task.

Planning (Emil): I’m best at data-science (0.84) and ui-ux-design (0.68). To avoid duplicate claims with Lawanna, I will tentatively target ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks only if other agents cover ui-ux. Given my lower ui-ux skill and high data-science costs, I prefer picking a ui-ux micro-task that Lawanna likely won’t take—currently cheapest for me is ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (cost 1.28) but Lawanna is considering those. I will instead take ISSUE-0001::test (cost 1.79) or ISSUE-0001::implement (2.56). Please confirm if anyone else wants test/implement.

Emil planning request: If Lawanna claims review/docs/triage, I can claim ISSUE-0001::test (high priority, effort 1.4). If she claims test too, I’ll take implement. I will not take ISSUE-0002 data-science due to very high cost vs my availability.
Emil (planning) will claim at execution time either ISSUE-0001::test or ISSUE-0001::implement depending on who takes test; otherwise skip. Not claiming any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks.

Planning update (Raymond): My best skills are data-science and documentation, but ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks are very high cost for me (review/test/implement). For ui-ux-design, my lowest cost is ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage=10? (all ui-ux costs high for me). To avoid duplicates with Lawanna, I will prefer taking ISSUE-0001::review OR ISSUE-0001::docs only if unclaimed; otherwise I may skip. Please confirm what ui-ux micro-task Emil/Lawanna take so I don’t duplicate.

Raymond request: If ui-ux review/docs/triage/test/implement are already covered by others, I’m inclined to skip in this iteration rather than take high-cost ui-ux-implement/test. My availability is 9h, but my costs for ui-ux tasks are ~10-20 except still 10 for review/docs/triage.

Planning update (Lamont): I’m best at data-science (but ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks are feasible only as review within 4h? actually review effort=4.0 fits) and documentation; ui-ux micro-tasks are feasible but my costs are very high (10-14-20). I will likely claim ISSUE-0002::review (high priority, effort 4.0) to avoid duplicating with ui-ux claims from Lawanna/Emil/Raymond. Please avoid claiming ISSUE-0002::review if you can.
Lamont coordination: I can cover ISSUE-0002::review only (cost=4.04, effort=4.0 equals my availability). I will skip other tasks to prevent infeasible over-commitment and avoid duplicates.

Frida (planning): I’m best at ui-ux-design; can take exactly one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux micro-task. Given my costs, cheapest are review/docs/triage (0.96 each). To avoid duplicates with Lawanna/Emil/Raymond, please confirm who is taking which among ISSUE-0001::review, ::docs, ::triage, ::test, ::implement. I will choose the first unclaimed among {review, docs, triage}.

Hipolito planning: given my strongest skill documentation+ui-ux and low costs for ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (1.36 each), I propose taking ISSUE-0001::docs if it’s unclaimed; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage; I will skip ISSUE-0002 due to infeasible/high cost. Please confirm who is taking review/test/implement.
Hipolito planning ask: to avoid duplicates, please reply with your intended picks for ISSUE-0001::review, ::test, ::implement, and whether ::docs or ::triage are taken by Lawanna/Frida.

Lawanna planning (execution choice yet to commit): I will claim exactly one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux-design micro-task. Based on lowest cost among my options, I prefer ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.09). Please do not also claim ISSUE-0001::review to avoid duplication; I will skip other ui-ux tasks and all data-science tasks.

Emil planning confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0001::test (high priority, effort 1.4) in execution unless it becomes taken by another agent; I will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks (too high cost). Please ensure ISSUE-0001::review is taken by Lawanna, and if so avoid taking ISSUE-0001::test to prevent duplicates.

Raymond planning: Per info, Lawanna likely takes ISSUE-0001::review; Emil likely takes ISSUE-0001::test. If those are taken, I will avoid remaining ui-ux (docs/triage/implement) due to high cost (~10-20). I’m requesting confirmation of who takes ISSUE-0001::docs and ISSUE-0001::triage and whether any ui-ux task remains unclaimed for me.
Raymond note: I can do a ui-ux micro-task only if it’s one of the few with lower cost for me; otherwise I will skip to minimize total cost and avoid duplicates.
Lamont planning: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0, cost 4.04) if unclaimed; I will skip all other tasks to avoid infeasible over-commitment and duplicates.

Frida planning: based on availability 4h and ui-ux skill, I will claim exactly one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux task. If ISSUE-0001::review is taken by Lawanna (likely), I will take the first unclaimed among ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage. Please confirm whether either docs/triage is already claimed by Hipolito/Lawanna; otherwise I’ll take docs before triage.

Hipolito planning: based on latest signals, assume Lawanna will take ISSUE-0001::review and Emil will take ISSUE-0001::test. To avoid duplicate, I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage. I will skip ISSUE-0001::implement (Emil likely later if test taken; but already handling test). Skipping ISSUE-0002 due to infeasible/high cost. Please confirm whether docs/triage are unclaimed by Frida/Lawanna.

Planning sync (Lawanna): I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::review (ui-ux) and will not take any other ISSUE-0001 ui-ux or any ISSUE-0002 data-science. Please coordinate remaining ui-ux tasks: allow Emil to take ISSUE-0001::test; next best are docs/triage/implement for others—avoid duplicates.

Emil planning update (iter1): I will execute-claim exactly one micro-task: ISSUE-0001::test (high priority, effort 1.4, cost 1.79) unless it’s already claimed in which case I’ll take ISSUE-0001::implement only if unclaimed. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks.

Planning sync (Raymond): I will avoid ISSUE-0002 data-science (too costly). For ISSUE-0001 ui-ux: assume Lawanna=review and Emil=test per earlier messages. Please confirm remaining unclaimed ui-ux tasks among {docs, triage, implement}. If both docs and triage are taken, I will skip; I cannot afford implement (cost 20) and would prefer avoid duplicates.

Lamont planning: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0, cost 4.04) if unclaimed; will skip other tasks. Please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplicate. I’m not taking ui-ux micro-tasks (too high cost).

Frida planning: I will take exactly one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux micro-task. Given Lawanna likely takes ISSUE-0001::review and Emil likely takes ISSUE-0001::test, I will choose the first unclaimed among ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage. Please confirm if either docs or triage is already taken by Hipolito/Lawanna/others before I commit.

Hipolito planning: confirm intent to take ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage. Will skip ISSUE-0002 (too costly). Please confirm whether docs/triage are already taken by Lawanna or Frida before execution.

Lawanna planning: I confirm I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (ui-ux-design, cost 1.09). I will not claim any other ui-ux or any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks. Please ensure remaining ui-ux tasks (docs/triage/test/implement) are claimed by others without duplicates.

Emil planning lock-in: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::test (only). I will not take implement/docs/triage and will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science. Please ensure nobody else claims ISSUE-0001::test to avoid duplicate.
Emil will not claim ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage/implement; expected owners: Lawanna=review, Frida/Hipolito=docs/triage, and Raymond/others skip or take remaining if unclaimed.

Planning sync (Raymond): I will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks (cost too high). For ISSUE-0001 ui-ux: based on signals, expecting Lawanna=review, Emil=test, leaving docs/triage/implement. Since my costs are ~10 for docs/triage and 20 for implement, I will claim nothing unless docs or triage is unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid high-cost/duplicate.
Lamont planning: I will claim only ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0, cost 4.04) if unclaimed. Please do not claim ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplication; I will skip all other tasks.

Frida planning update: I’m choosing ISSUE-0001::docs if it’s unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage. Please confirm whether Hipolito is taking docs and whether any other agent has claimed it, so we avoid duplicates (phase=planning, iter=1).

Planning coordination (Hipolito): I intend to take ISSUE-0001::docs in execution if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage. I will skip all ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please confirm if docs is already claimed by Hipolito (me) vs Frida/Lawanna before execution to avoid duplicates.
